purpose: Define the contamination predicate for Illinois downstate linear topology under overlay evaluation.

inputs.E: effective graph after applying scoped overlay without mutating B

not_contaminated_if_all_hold.definition: The set of county node ids in the downstate chain is identical between B and E.
The relative order of every pair of downstate counties is identical between B and E.
If the chain is edge-encoded, downstate chain edge sets are identical between B and E.
Every downstate county node has the same parent in B and E.
Cook-scoped edges do not change reachability among downstate counties outside Cook-local-only evaluation.

invariants: Cook may not insert itself into the downstate chain.
Cook may not reorder downstate counties.
Cook may not reparent downstate jurisdictions.
Cook may not create alternative global paths through the downstate chain.
Chicago and municipal overlays must operate above a proven intact downstate baseline.
